title: KVM: BUG: kernel NULL dereference in kvm_vcpu_fault_in_page (synthetic)
description: SYNTHETIC ILLUSTRATIVE ARTIFACT, NOT ONE OF THE EVALUATED DEFECTS. This file exists only to demonstrate CHIRON's input schema and pipeline on an artificial crash. A fuzzer exercised concurrent guest stage-2 page faults during a vCPU teardown; the fault handler dereferenced a vCPU mmu context that had been detached, crashing on a NULL stage-2 context. Nothing here corresponds to a real upstream defect, and it is intentionally unrelated to the paper's evaluated bugs.
